item.title: AWS re:Invent 2026 to Showcase AWS Continuum and Security for AI Agents
item.description:
AWS re:Invent 2026 to Showcase AWS Continuum and Security for AI Agents

The AWS Security, Identity, and Governance team has announced the security session lineup for AWS re:Invent in Las Vegas, running from November 30 to December 4, 2026. The event will showcase new developments in AWS Continuum, a service designed to automate security workflows, alongside sessions on governance and authentication for autonomous AI agents.

🔍 Overview

AWS re:Invent 2026 features nearly 120 security sessions across breakouts, chalk talks, workshops, code talks, builders’ sessions, and lightning talks. Security sessions begin Monday morning and run through Friday, with Tuesday and Wednesday sessions distributed across the Wynn, MGM Grand, and Caesars Palace. On Thursday, December 3, the Wynn venue hosts a full day of advanced security sessions with 78 sessions from 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM, the majority of which are at the 300 level or above. This includes 12 workshops, 11 builders’ sessions, and 22 chalk talks.

⚙️ Key Sessions for AWS Continuum and Security

The event includes dedicated sessions detailing the capabilities of AWS Continuum and secure architectures for AI workloads:

Session Day & Time Format Description
SEC388 Monday 10:00 AM Breakout National Institutes of Health shares how it manages identity lifecycle across clouds.
SEC302 Monday 10:00 AM Breakout Building a governance foundation for AI workloads that grows with autonomous agents.
SEC427 Monday 12:00 PM Code Talk Threat models an agentic development workflow from user story to deployment with AWS Continuum.
SEC424 Tuesday 2:30 PM Chalk Talk How IAM evaluates policies on every request.
SEC312 Tuesday 3:30 PM Workshop Run an on-demand penetration test against a live application with AWS Continuum.
SEC323 Tuesday 3:30 PM Workshop Recover from a simulated ransomware event and prove the restore is clean.
SEC362 Thursday 8:00 AM Workshop Build authentication, authorization, and audit for AI agents.
SEC349 Thursday 8:30 AM Workshop Build a layered controls stack for a fleet of agents.
SEC419 Thursday 11:30 AM Chalk Talk OAuth delegation patterns for agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity.
SEC405 Thursday 12:00 PM Builders’ Session Take a vulnerable application from discovery to fix with Amazon Inspector, AWS Continuum, and Amazon GuardDuty.
SEC501 Thursday 1:00 PM Breakout Goes inside the research behind the GuardDuty detection engine.
SEC311 Thursday 1:00 PM Builders’ Session Wires AWS frontier agents into an automated find-and-fix security loop.
SEC384 Thursday 2:30 PM Breakout How AWS Continuum discovers, validates, and fixes code vulnerabilities in one workflow.
SEC390 Thursday 4:00 PM Breakout Woodside handed SOC monitoring to AWS Security Incident Response to focus on threat hunting.

🎤 Keynotes and Featured Speakers

Several key leadership presentations are scheduled for the event:

  • Chet Kapoor (AWS VP of Security, Search, and Observability) presents “The Future of Security” at 11:00 AM.
  • Amy Herzog (AWS Chief Information Security Officer) presents “The Old Security Playbook Is Dead” at 1:00 PM.
  • Eric Brandwine (VP/Distinguished Engineer, AWS Security) presents “Operationalizing security for the future with best practices today” at 3:00 PM.

The Thursday keynote runs from 8:30 to 10:00 AM at The Venetian and is also streamed online.
